environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EKS with default container configuration. Pod runs with standard writable overlay filesystem. No network policies applied to the namespace. Service account has default token mounted. The /app/config/allowed_domains.json file does not exist in the container image (was never baked in during CI), causing the allowlist to return empty array and the redirect/fetch endpoints to operate in permissive mode. Internal metadata service (169.254.169.254) is reachable from pod network. IMDSv1 is enabled on the node.
